main_text.p: fidentia, Heb. מַחְסֶה receptus, refugium, Prov. 14.26.
ܟܪܝܬܐ Syr. Certò, fidenter, confidenter, ad Philip. 1.25. & ad Hebr. 13.6.
תְּכֵלָא ܬܟܠܐ Ch. Hyacinthus: Hyacinthinù. Heb. תְּכֵלֶת. ܐܬܟܠܐ Ch. Botrus, bacca. Plur. אַתְכְּלִין, Botri, Hebr. אַשְׁכּוֹל.
תִּבַּן Hinc Præter. Aphel אַתְבְּנוּן Firmavit ea, Jef. 48. 5. juxta Regia. Sic melius legeretur אַתְבְּנָנוּן. Partic. מִתְבְּנִין Parant, præparant, Jobi 15.35.

תְּבַם Ch. Terere, strepere pedibus. Partic. תָּבֵם בִּתְּבַלּוּי Terens pedibus suis, Prov. 6.13. Pahel ܬܒܡ Syr. Impedire, 1. ad Corinth. 9.12. Aucupari, Carpere verba alicujus, Lucæ 11.53. Ethpahel ܐܬܬܒܡ Impediri, ad Rom. 15.22. Jac. 3.8.
תְּבַף Ch. Statim, subito, cito, repente, derepente, momento.

תְּלָא Ch. & Syr. Pendit, appendit, suspendit: Suspendendo Extendit, tetendit. Ithpehal אִתְּלִי Suspensus fuit, 2. Sam. 18.9. Plur. אִתְלִיאוּ Septem generationes suspensæ sunt Caino, Gen. 4.24. in Onk. & Jonath. in quo abest א. Part. Syr. ܬܠܝܐ Qui suspenditur, ad Gal. 3.13.
תְּלַג Chald. & Syr. Nix. Ab Hebraeo שְׁלַג per commutationem ש & ת.
תָּלַל Hebr. Aggerare, aggerere, accumulare. Hinc תל
